producer_report.summary: Added one characterization test, `produce_and_verify_order_tests::a_fake_job_takes_its_baseline_before_the_producer_and_numbers_the_invocations_in_order`, at the end of run.rs. It runs a fake job through `Athena::go` with a recording Ui and a capability that has one check, `probe`. It asserts the UI order (dispatched, `baseline   probe ok`, producer, candidate, checks, verifier, then landed). It also asserts the invocation numbers: reader 1, producer 2, verifier 3, and `baseline.before_invocation == 2`. I added a CHANGELOG entry. No existing test or non-test code changed; the run.rs diff is insertions only. I did not run the full `cargo test --locked`.

checks_run.note: Passes after the final fmt, and fails with the baseline mutation applied. Full suite not run.
Run for athena-core only; Athena runs the workspace check.
Applied formatting; I did not run `--check` separately.

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test --locked: a new test drives a fake job through produce_and_verify and passes; it asserts the exact order of ui.line output and the invocation numbers.
criteria_check.evidence: I ran `cargo test --locked -p athena-core produce_and_verify_order`; the new test passes after fmt. It drives `Athena::go`, which calls `produce_and_verify`. It asserts the six lines from dispatched to verifier, and invocations (1,Reader),(2,Producer),(3,Verifier). It also asserts baseline.before_invocation == 2. Producer, candidate, checks and verifier lines are matched by prefix and suffix, because the wall times in them vary. I did not run the full suite.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff only adds one test (plus helpers it needs) in run.rs; no existing test and no non-test code is changed, and the earlier test list is unchanged except for the one new name.
criteria_check.evidence: `git diff --stat` shows 279 insertions and 0 deletions in run.rs. The addition is a new `#[cfg(test)] mod produce_and_verify_order_tests` with one #[test]. The Docs capability, Lines Ui, athena() and repo() are its helpers. The temporary mutation was reverted by exact reverse edits; the deletion count of 0 confirms it.

criteria_check.criterion: The test would fail if closing.baseline were set after the producer instead of before (the check in design doc section 5, R0 row); the report says how this was established.
criteria_check.evidence: I temporarily wrapped the baseline block (take_baseline, the baseline line, `closing.baseline = Some(..)`) in a closure and called it after the producer loop, before the change list. The test then failed at the line-order assertion: left was the producer line, right was `baseline   probe ok`. I reverted the mutation, and the passing run above comes after the revert.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo fmt --all --check and cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -p athena-core -- -D warnings`; both were clean.

criteria_check.evidence: A new bullet under [Unreleased] / Added in CHANGELOG.md describes the test and what it asserts.

criteria_check.criterion: Only the files run.rs and CHANGELOG.md change; nothing is moved, so the section 5 move proof (re-exports, caller checks) holds trivially and the report states that.
criteria_check.evidence: `git diff --stat` lists only CHANGELOG.md and crates/athena-core/src/run.rs. Nothing is moved, so the test list is unchanged except for the one new name. No name moved, so re-exports and the per-name caller check hold vacuously.

open_issues: The test duplicates about 150 lines of fixture from scope_guard.rs, because the brief limits changes to run.rs and CHANGELOG.md. A later job could share a common fixture.
mistakes: My first mutation attempt was a malformed edit; I reverted it and redid the mutation cleanly. The final diff has no deletions.
learnings: The run-level test fixtures (Capability stub, repo, scripted fake agents) are private to run_pin_tests.rs and scope_guard.rs, so a test confined to run.rs has to carry its own copy.
A fake job's reader is invocation 1 and the baseline's before_invocation is the producer's number.
The job's UI lines start with the stage name padded with spaces: `baseline   `, `producer   `, `candidate  `, `checks     `, `verifier   `.
